content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have created a simple webpage to display information for my test application, and everything works fine. On this page, I show the current time using the [product_name] 'CLOCK' component, but it only displays time in the 24-hour format (e.g., 13:00 instead of 1 pm). Is there any way to switch to a 12-hour time format? I've checked the forums and documentation but haven't found a solution.
This isn’t possible with the standard resources of [product_name]. If you have experience with HTML5, you could potentially program a workaround to convert the format.
Thank you for your response. Unfortunately, I don't have HTML5 programming skills, so I'll have to stick with the 24-hour display, even though it's not my preference.
That’s just one way to look at it. Personally, I find the 12-hour format more confusing. You could consider submitting a support ticket and request an option to select the 12-hour format as well.
That's a good idea, but it doesn't seem worth making it official. I'll just get used to the 24-hour format—thanks!

analysis.insight_summary: Users enjoy being able to show current time on custom webpages using the [product_name], but are frustrated by the inability to easily select between 24-hour and 12-hour formats. The restriction to 24-hour format affects users who prefer or require a 12-hour display, making the user experience less flexible.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a straightforward option to pick between 24-hour and 12-hour time formats in the [product_name] interface, without the need for programming.
